components.description: Six weeks of paid leave at 100% of base salary for a faculty member who becomes a parent by birth (either parent), adoption or foster placement, after one academic year of service; runs concurrently with FMLA.
components.faculty_group_note: CBA Art. I.H: 'Faculty' = full-time tenured or tenure-track faculty of academic rank; Art. II s.1: the unit includes all Kent Campus and Regional Campus full-time teaching and research faculty
components.eligible_parent_wording: birth mother, birth father, adoptive parent, foster care parent with legal custody or guardianship, same sex spouse, or domestic partner
components.service_requirement: at least one full academic year of service, excluding summer sessions, before the leave begins (pro-rated benefit if the year is completed while on leave for the event)
components.entitlement_note: 'The University will provide paid parental leave'; 'will be eligible for six (6) weeks'. Approval concerns intermittent use and use outside the 12-week window, not the grant.
components.pay_fraction: 100% of the Faculty member’s regular base salary
components.relief_note: A paid leave; no relief stated, so all duties relieved (R9).
components.time_window: should be used during the twelve (12) weeks immediately following the birth, adoption, or foster care placement (exceptions case by case with approval)
components.return_obligation: return to full-time work for at least one full academic year, excluding summer sessions, or reimburse the salary received during the leave (waivable for non-reappointment, denial of tenure, disabling condition, newborn's serious condition, other circumstances beyond the employee's control)

faculty_group: "Faculty", "members of the Faculty", and "Faculty members" -- full-time faculty of academic rank who hold tenured or tenure-track appointments at the University

eligible_parent: In order to be eligible for Paid Parental Leave, a Faculty member must have become a new parent as a birth mother, birth father, adoptive parent, foster care parent with legal custody or guardianship, same sex spouse, or domestic partner.
entitlement: The University will provide paid parental leave to Faculty members to recover from childbirth and/or to care for or bond with a child.

A Faculty member will be eligible for six (6) weeks of Paid Parental Leave for a birth mother, birth father, adoptive parent, foster care parent with legal custody or guardianship, same sex spouse, or domestic partner to care for and bond with a newborn, newly adoptive child, or newly fostered child.
duration: A Faculty member will be eligible for six (6) weeks of Paid Parental Leave for a birth mother, birth father, adoptive parent, foster care parent with legal custody or guardianship, same sex spouse, or domestic partner to care for and bond with a newborn, newly adoptive child, or newly fostered child.

notes: Reference date 2018-02-22. The CBA (effective 2015-08-19 to 2018-08-18) and the policy-register pages (effective dates 2015; Wayback copies 2016-08 to 2018-01) were in force on that date as far as the documents show.
The CBA is a governing collective agreement for tenured and tenure-track faculty (Kent and regional campuses), so missing = false.

Chain, birth parent: pregnancy disability leave without pay (c6, up to 6 months; own sick leave c3 within it from its start; FMLA c10 concurrent from its start) | Paid Parental Leave c1 6 weeks (FMLA concurrent) -> own sick/vacation supplement c2 6 weeks also available (order at the member's choice); donated pool c5 after own sick leave c3; general temporary disability leave c7 after sick leave c3; child care leave c8 (discretionary, no length) after c6.

Chain, non-birth parent: Paid Parental Leave c1 6 weeks with FMLA c10 12 weeks concurrent -> own sick/vacation supplement c2 6 weeks also available, to the end of the 12 FMLA weeks; post-natal sick leave days c4 (up to 5 days, discretionary, own balance) unplaced; child care leave c8 (discretionary, no length) unplaced.
Paid Parental Leave renews per event ('One Paid Parental Leave benefit is available per Faculty member, per birth, adoption, or foster care placement event'): not a use limit (U9).

Policy 6-11.9 states 'The university does not provide leaves of absence with pay for faculty'; read as about general leaves of absence; the CBA's Paid Parental Leave (Art. XIV s.11) governs paid parental leave for bargaining-unit faculty.

Calendar: the documents name semesters ('spring or fall semesters or the ten-week summer session') without a semester length: calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. No component is stated in semesters.
C8: FMLA intermittent and reduced-schedule leave are forms of the FMLA leave (c10), not a separate part-time option.
